entries.name: Agile
entries.ruleText: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2” when using Rush/Charge.

entries.name: Ambush Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Ambush.

entries.name: Ambush Beacon
entries.ruleText: Friendly units using Ambush may ignore distance restrictions from enemies if they are deployed within 6" of this model.

entries.name: Ambush Re-Deployment
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when a unit where all models have this rule ends its activation, you may immediately remove it from the table (dropping any objectives it might hold within 1"), and deploy it as if it had Ambush at the beginning of the next round.

entries.name: Ambushing Piercing Shot
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule.

entries.name: Armor
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Defense X+.

entries.name: Bad Shot
entries.ruleText: This model gets -1 to hit rolls when shooting.

entries.name: Bane Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Bane when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Bane in Melee Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Bane in melee.

entries.name: Bane in Melee Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Bane in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Bane when Shooting Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Bane when shooting.

entries.name: Battleborn
entries.ruleText: If a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

entries.name: Bloodborn
entries.ruleText: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

entries.name: Bounding
entries.ruleText: When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3+1" of their position.

entries.name: Bounding Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Bounding.

entries.name: Breath Attack
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, roll one die. On a 2+ one enemy unit within 6" in line of sight takes 1 hit with Blast(3) and AP(1).

entries.name: Brutal Fighter
entries.ruleText: When in melee, unmodified results of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

entries.name: Caster Group
entries.ruleText: Pick one model with this rule in this unit to have Caster(X), where X is the total number of models with this rule in this unit. If the model is killed, pick another to be the new caster, and transfer all spell tokens to it. The caster loses all unspent spell tokens at the end of the round.

entries.name: Casting Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 12" with Caster, which gets +1 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Casting Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight with Caster, which gets -1 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Changebound Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Changebound Boost.

entries.name: Clan Warrior Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Clan Warrior Boost.

entries.name: Coordinate
entries.ruleText: At the end of this unit's activation, another friendly unit within 12" that hasn't activated yet may be activated immediately. May not be used if this unit was activated via Coordinate.

entries.name: Counter-Attack Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Counter-Attack.

entries.name: Courage Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls.

entries.name: Courage Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Crossing Attack
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

entries.name: Dangerous Terrain Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous Terrain once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Darkborn
entries.ruleText: Enemies get -4" range to a min. of 6" when trying to shoot at units where all models have this rule, and -2" movement to a min. of 6" when trying to charge units where all models have this rule.

entries.name: Dash
entries.ruleText: Once per round, at the end of this unit's activation, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3+1" of their position.

entries.name: Dash Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Dash.

entries.name: Deathstrike
entries.ruleText: If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits.

entries.name: Defensive Frenzy
entries.ruleText: If all models in this unit have this rule, place one marker on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two markers. For each marker this unit gets +1 to Defense rolls until the end of the game.

entries.name: Defensive Growth Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Defensive Growth.

entries.name: Delayed Action
entries.ruleText: Once per round, if your opponent has more units left to activate than you, then this model's unit may pass its turn instead of activating (may still be activated later).

entries.name: Devout Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Devout Boost.

entries.name: Difficult Terrain Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Difficult Terrain once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Entrenched Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Entrenched once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Evasive Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Evasive.

entries.name: Extended Buff Range
entries.ruleText: If this unit is within 24" of another friendly unit with this rule that has a Hero in it, then that Hero may use special rules that allow it to pick friendly units within 12" (except for spells) on this unit as if it was in range.

entries.name: Fanatic
entries.ruleText: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9” of its position.

entries.name: Fast Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions.

entries.name: Fatigue Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which must take a morale test. If failed, it becomes fatigued.

entries.name: Fearless Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Fearless.

entries.name: Ferocious Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Ferocious Boost.

entries.name: Fortified
entries.ruleText: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

entries.name: Fortified Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Fortified.

entries.name: Fortified Growth
entries.ruleText: If all models in this unit have this rule,  place one marker on it at the beginning of each round if it's on the table and isn't Shaken, up to a max. of four markers. For every two markers, enemies attacking this unit get AP(-1) to a min. of AP(0).

entries.name: Furious Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Furious.

entries.name: Furious Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Furious once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Furious Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Furious against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Grounded Precision Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Grounded Precision.

entries.name: Grounded Reinforcement Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Grounded Reinforcement.

entries.name: Grounded Stealth
entries.ruleText: If a unit where all models have this rule has most of them within 1" of terrain, enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking them.

entries.name: Guarded Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Guarded once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Guardian Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Guardian Boost.

entries.name: Guerrilla
entries.ruleText: Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

entries.name: Guerrilla Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Guerrilla Boost.

entries.name: Harassing Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Harassing Boost.

entries.name: Havocbound Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Havocbound Boost.

entries.name: Heavy Impact
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Impact(X) with hits that have AP(1).

entries.name: Highborn Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Highborn Boost.

entries.name: Hit & Run
entries.ruleText: Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

entries.name: Hit & Run Fighter Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Hit & Run Fighter.

entries.name: Hit & Run Shooter Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Hit & Run Shooter.

entries.name: Hive Bond Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Hive Bond Boost.

entries.name: Hold the Line Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Hold the Line Boost.

entries.name: Honor Code
entries.ruleText: If a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

entries.name: Ignores Cover Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Ignores Cover when shooting.

entries.name: Ignores Cover when Shooting Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Ignores Cover when shooting.

entries.name: Increased Shooting Range
entries.ruleText: This model gets +6" range when shooting.

entries.name: Increased Shooting Range Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get +6" range when shooting.

entries.name: Increased Shooting Range Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +6" range when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Increased Shooting Range Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +6" range when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Indirect Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Indirect against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Indirect when Shooting Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Indirect when shooting.

entries.name: Infected Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Infected Boost.

entries.name: Infiltrate
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3” away from enemy unit.

entries.name: Infiltrate Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Infiltrate.

entries.name: Inquisitorial Agent
entries.ruleText: Once per game, if all models in this unit have this rule, it may be activated even if it had already activated this round (stops being fatigued when activated for the second time). Only up to one third of the units in the army with this rule at the beginning of the game (rounding up) may use it in a single round.

entries.name: Instinctive
entries.ruleText: When this model is activated, if it is able to shoot/charge an enemy unit, then it must immediately attack the closest valid target and gets +1 to hit rolls for that attack.

entries.name: Knightborn
entries.ruleText: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 4+ instead.

entries.name: Lustbound Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Lustbound Boost.

entries.name: Machine-Fog Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Machine-Fog Boost.

entries.name: Martial Prowess
entries.ruleText: Once per game, if all models in this unit have this rule, it may be activated even if it had already activated this round (stops being fatigued when activated for the second time). Only up to one third of the units in the army with this rule at the beginning of the game (rounding up) may use it in a single round.

entries.name: Melee Evasion Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Melee Evasion.

entries.name: Melee Shrouding
entries.ruleText: Enemies get -3" movement to a min. of 6" when trying to charge units where all models have this rule.

entries.name: Melee Shrouding Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Melee Shrouding.

entries.name: Melee Slayer Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Melee Slayer.

entries.name: Mend
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

entries.name: Mind Control
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which must take a morale test. If failed you may move it by up to 6" in a straight line in any direction.

entries.name: Mischievous Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Mischievous Boost.

entries.name: Mobile Artillery
entries.ruleText: When this model uses a Hold action and shoots at enemies over 9" away, it gets +1 to hit rolls. As long this model hasn't moved during the round, when enemy units shoot at it from over 9" away, they get -2 to hit rolls.

entries.name: Morale Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: No Retreat
entries.ruleText: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a morale test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

entries.name: No Retreat Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get No Retreat.

entries.name: No Retreat Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets No Retreat once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Piercing Assault Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Piercing Assault.

entries.name: Piercing Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which loses AP(+1) when attacking once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Piercing Fighter Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get AP(+1) in melee.

entries.name: Piercing Frenzy
entries.ruleText: Place one marker on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two markers. For each marker all models with this rule in this unit get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking until the end of the game.

entries.name: Piercing Growth
entries.ruleText: Place one marker on this unit at the beginning of each round if it's on the table and isn't Shaken, up to a max. of four markers. For every two markers, models with this rule in this unit get AP(+1) on their weapons.

entries.name: Piercing Hunter Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Piercing Hunter.

entries.name: Piercing Shooter Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get AP(+1) when shooting.

entries.name: Piercing Shooting Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets AP(+1) when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Piercing Spotter
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, pick one enemy unit within 30" and in line of sight of this model and roll one die, on a 4+ place a marker on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove markers from their target before rolling to block to get +AP(X) on their weapons, where X is the number of removed markers.

entries.name: Piercing Tag
entries.ruleText: Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove markers from their target before rolling to block to get +AP(Y) on their weapons, where Y is the number of removed markers.

entries.name: Piercing Target
entries.ruleText: Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. Friendly units get +AP(X) on their weapons when attacking it.

entries.name: Plaguebound Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Plaguebound Boost.

entries.name: Point-Blank Piercing Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Point-Blank Piercing.

entries.name: Precision Attacks Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls when attacking once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Precision Charge Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls when charging.

entries.name: Precision Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to hit rolls when attacking once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Precision Fighter Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls in melee.

entries.name: Precision Fighter Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Precision Fighting Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls in melee against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Precision Frenzy
entries.ruleText: Place one marker on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two markers. For each marker all models with this rule in this unit get +1 to hit rolls until the end of the game.

entries.name: Precision Growth
entries.ruleText: Place one marker on this unit at the beginning of each round if it's on the table and isn't Shaken, up to a max. of four markers. For every two markers, models with this rule in this unit get +1 to hit rolls.

entries.name: Precision Shooter Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls when shooting.

entries.name: Precision Shooter Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Precision Shooting Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Precision Spotter
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, pick one enemy unit within 30" and in line of sight of this model and roll one die, on a 4+ place a marker on it. Friendly units may remove markers from their target before rolling to hit to get +X to hit rolls when attacking, where X is the number of removed markers.

entries.name: Precision Tag
entries.ruleText: Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove markers from their target before rolling to hit to get +Y to hit rolls, where Y is the number of removed markers.

entries.name: Precision Target
entries.ruleText: Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls when attacking it.

entries.name: Predator Shooter Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Predator Shooter.

entries.name: Primal Boost Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Primal Boost once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Primeborn
entries.ruleText: When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away and take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

entries.name: Protected
entries.ruleText: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

entries.name: Protected Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Protected.

entries.name: Protection Feat
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when this unit takes wounds and all its models have this rule, you may use this rule and roll one die per wound, and on a 5+ it is ignored.

entries.name: Protection Feat Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Protection Feat.

entries.name: Quick Readjustment
entries.ruleText: This model ignores penalties from shooting after moving when using Indirect weapons.

entries.name: Quick Shot Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Quick Shot.

entries.name: Quick Shot Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Quick Shot against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Ranged Shrouding Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Ranged Shrouding.

entries.name: Ranged Slayer Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Ranged Slayer.

entries.name: Rapid Advance Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Rapid Advance.

entries.name: Rapid Advance Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Rapid Advance once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Rapid Ambush
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed at the start of any round, including the first.

entries.name: Rapid Blink Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Rapid Blink Boost.

entries.name: Rapid Charge
entries.ruleText: This model moves +4" when using Charge actions.

entries.name: Rapid Charge Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit moves +4" when using Charge actions.

entries.name: Rapid Rush Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Rapid Rush.

entries.name: Ravage
entries.ruleText: When it's this model's turn to attack in melee, roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

entries.name: Re-Deployment
entries.ruleText: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next.

entries.name: Re-Position Artillery
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, pick one friendly model within 6" with Artillery, which may immediately move by up to 9".

entries.name: Reanimation Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Reanimation.

entries.name: Regeneration Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Regeneration.

entries.name: Regeneration Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Regeneration once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Regenerative Strength
entries.ruleText: Place one marker on this model when it ignores a wound. When in melee, pick one of its weapons to get +X attacks, where X is the number of markers on it.

entries.name: Reinforcement
entries.ruleText: When a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken or fully destroyed, you may remove it from the table as destroyed and place a new copy of it fully within 12" of any table edge at the beginning of the next round after Ambushers have been deployed. Units that deploy via Reinforcement can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy, and this rule doesn’t apply to the new copy of the unit.

entries.name: Relentless Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Relentless.

entries.name: Relentless Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Relentless against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Rending Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Rending against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Rending in Melee Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Rending in melee.

entries.name: Rending when Shooting Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Rending when shooting.

entries.name: Repel Ambushers
entries.ruleText: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

entries.name: Resistance Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Resistance.

entries.name: Retaliate
entries.ruleText: When this model takes wounds in melee, the attacker takes X hits per wound taken.

entries.name: Scout Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Scout.

entries.name: Scrapper Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Scrapper Boost.

entries.name: Screened Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Screened.

entries.name: Scurry Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Scurry Boost.

entries.name: Self-Destruct
entries.ruleText: If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits. If this model survives melee, after both sides have finished attacking, it is immediately killed, and the enemy unit takes X hits.

entries.name: Self-Repair Boost Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Self-Repair Boost once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Shielded Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Shielded.

entries.name: Shred Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Shred when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Shred in Melee Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Shred in melee.

entries.name: Shred when Shooting Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Shred when shooting.

entries.name: Slayer Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Slayer against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Spawn
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when this model is activated, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it.

entries.name: Speed Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Speed Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which moves -2" when using Advance actions and -4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Speed Feat Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Speed Feat.

entries.name: Spell Accumulator
entries.ruleText: Gets X accumulator tokens at the start of each round, but can’t hold more than 6 tokens at once. Casters from other friendly units within 12" may spend this model's accumulator tokens as if they were their own spell tokens. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

entries.name: Spell Conduit
entries.ruleText: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

entries.name: Split
entries.ruleText: When this unit is fully destroyed, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it before removing the last model.

entries.name: Steadfast
entries.ruleText: If a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

entries.name: Steadfast Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Steadfast.

entries.name: Stealth Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Stealth.

entries.name: Stealth Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Stealth once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Storm of Change
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when this model is activated, before attacking, roll 3 dice. For each 2+ one enemy unit within 12" takes 3 hits with Shred.

entries.name: Storm of Lust
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when this model is activated, before attacking, roll 3 dice. For each 2+ one enemy unit within 12" takes 3 hits with Surge (roll one die per hit to see if it triggers).

entries.name: Storm of Plague
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when this model is activated, before attacking, roll 3 dice. For each 2+ one enemy unit within 12" takes 3 hits with Bane.

entries.name: Storm of War
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when this model is activated, before attacking, roll 3 dice. For each 2+ one enemy unit within 12" takes 3 hits with AP(1).

entries.name: Strafing
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way.

entries.name: Strider Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Strider.

entries.name: Sturdy Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Sturdy Boost.

entries.name: Surprise Attack
entries.ruleText: Counts as having Infiltrate. The first time this unit is activated, pick one enemy unit within 6" in line of sight, and roll X dice. For each 2+ it takes one hit with AP(1).

entries.name: Swift
entries.ruleText: This model may ignore the Slow rule.

entries.name: Swift Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Swift.

entries.name: Swift Buff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Swift once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Takedown Shot
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when this model shoots, it may make one extra attack against the target at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

entries.name: Takedown Strike
entries.ruleText: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to attack in melee, it may make one attack at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

entries.name: Targeting Visor Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Targeting Visor Boost.

entries.name: Teleport Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Teleport.

entries.name: Thrust in Melee Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Thrust in melee.

entries.name: Unique
entries.ruleText: This unit may only be taken once per army.

entries.name: Unpredictable
entries.ruleText: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

entries.name: Unpredictable Fighter Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Unpredictable Fighter.

entries.name: Unpredictable Fighter Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unpredictable Fighter against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Unpredictable Shooter Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Unpredictable Shooter.

entries.name: Unpredictable Shooter Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unpredictable Shooter against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Unstoppable Mark
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unstoppable against once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Unstoppable in Melee Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Unstoppable in melee.

entries.name: Unstoppable when Shooting Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Unstoppable when shooting.

entries.name: Unwieldy Debuff
entries.ruleText: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets Unwieldy in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

entries.name: Vanguard
entries.ruleText: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9” of its position.

entries.name: Vengeance
entries.ruleText: When this unit is fully destroyed, place as many Vengeance markers on the unit that destroyed it as models with this rule in this unit at the beginning of the game. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls when attacking that unit, where X is the number of markers on it.

entries.name: Versatile Attack
entries.ruleText: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.

entries.name: Versatile Defense Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Versatile Defense.

entries.name: Versatile Reach Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Versatile Reach.

entries.name: Warbound Boost Aura
entries.ruleText: This model and its unit get Warbound Boost.

entries.name: Watchborn
entries.ruleText: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.

entries.name: Wolfborn
entries.ruleText: When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3" of their position.
